FN-GXAW66C-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 39
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator Clyde Chambliss
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/07/2024
Senate Bill 39 as introduced would require certain state-owned dams and reservoirs to be
inspected by an engineer at least once every five years, provided that sufficient funds, either
through Legislative appropriation or grant funds, have been obtained by the participating owner
of the state-owned dam or reservoir.
Page 1

FN-GXAW66C-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 39
Committee: Ports, Waterways, and Intermodal Transit Sponsor: Senator Clyde Chambliss
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/13/2024
Senate Bill 39 as passed the Senate would provide for certain state-owned dams and reservoirs
to be inspected by an engineer a minimum of every four years, provided that sufficient funds
have been obtained by the participating owner of the state-owned dam or reservoir, either
through legislative appropriation or grant funds.
